text:
𝗦𝗜𝗫𝗘𝗦 𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚𝗦! 🇦🇫

Afghanistan beat Australia by 4 wickets in the Hong Kong Sixes final, chasing 116 in 5.1 overs.

Imran Mir smashed 53* off 14 🔥

#Cricket #HongKongSixes

𝗔𝗙𝗚𝗛𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗡 𝗦𝗜𝗫𝗘𝗦 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗠𝗣𝗜𝗢𝗡! 🇦🇫🔥

👉 Hong Kong Sixes final mein Afghanistan ne Australia ko 4 wickets se haraya
👉 Australia 115/5, Afghanistan 119/2 (5.1 ov)
👉 Imran Mir 53* off 14, Player of the Match
👉 Semi-final mein Gulbadin Naib ka 51* off 16

Kya Afghanistan ab bade T20 tournaments mein bhi dhamaal machayega? Comment karo 👇
